It records the decisions for 「要设计的内容」 1–5 (re-measured, not inherited): vocabulary keys on measures and dimensions (D1), tools defined once for chat and MCP (D2/D4), the selection rule with a labelled fallback (D3), the measurement (D5), and the permission reading (no leak, no finding card). - **Landing.** Tier H, `docs/adr/**`. The PR needs an APPROVE from os-zhuang or hotlong; both are requested, and the seat does not approve. After an approval and green CI on this head, the seat runs the governed and expected-skips checks and enqueues. The seat files the six D7 child cards once the PR has merged.
